header: Setup guides for Microsoft Defender XDR
content:
Article • 04/25/2025 • Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR
Setup guides for Microsoft Defender XDR deployment give you tailored guidance and
resources for planning and deploying security controls for your tenant, apps, and services.
All setup guides are available in the Microsoft 365 admin center
and in the Microsoft 365
Setup portal
.
Setup guides in the admin center require authentication to a Microsoft 365 tenant as an
administrator or other role with access to the admin center, but guides in the Microsoft 365
Setup portal can be accessed by anyone. The following table provides links to both locations
for each guide, where available.
